branch_decisions.comparison_baseline: 2023H2 strong period versus 2025H1/2025H2 adjacent validation/followthrough periods
branch_decisions.decision_reason: positive net survived but PF thinned, drawdown widened, late segment turned negative, and 18 negative slices remained.
branch_decisions.do_not_repeat: Do not add a third narrow anti_overconstraint filter repair stage.
branch_decisions.next_use: Preserve the 2023H2 momentum clue, but do not treat this variant as a research baseline candidate.
branch_decisions.salvage_value: The strong 2023H2 late net suggests a direction/impulse interaction worth testing outside this filter stack.
branch_decisions.stop_condition: If the next pool-wide directional/impulse queue cannot improve 2025H1/2025H2 PF and drawdown, close this branch as negative memory.

branch_decisions.decision_reason: Sell side was the deepest 2025H1 loss and also weak in 2025H2, so one shared surface is probably hiding side-specific behavior.
branch_decisions.do_not_repeat: Do not simply ban sell trades or add a hard side blacklist.
branch_decisions.next_use: Design side-specific margin/rank reweighting across the full baseline pool.
branch_decisions.salvage_value: Side asymmetry may expose long continuation versus short reversal differences.
branch_decisions.stop_condition: If side-specific score tables only reduce trade count without raising PF/DD resilience, downgrade the side branch.

branch_decisions.decision_reason: Weakness appears across direction, hour, weekday, month, and late segment rather than one clean calendar bucket.
branch_decisions.do_not_repeat: Do not patch 16/19/20 hour or Monday/Wednesday with direct calendar gates.
branch_decisions.next_use: Use time slices as diagnostics for non-calendar state features, not as hard filters.
branch_decisions.salvage_value: Time concentration can guide volatility/impulse state construction.
branch_decisions.stop_condition: If non-calendar states still map to the same weak time buckets, record as structural fragility.

branch_decisions.decision_reason: The branch should pivot from adding filters to testing a stronger directional/impulse feature family.
branch_decisions.do_not_repeat: Do not keep tuning one s264_aih threshold to hide weak months.
branch_decisions.next_use: Materialize run267BS as a pool-wide directional asymmetry and impulse replacement queue.
branch_decisions.observed_change: 2023H2 strong upside coexists with 2025 fragile followthrough.
branch_decisions.salvage_value: A broader explosive branch can test whether the edge is a real market structure rather than a filter accident.
branch_decisions.stop_condition: Stop after one materialization/execution/review loop if broad branch also shows weak cross-period durability.
